in_sanskrit.name: Lobsang
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Dedicated to Buddha
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lobsang एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Tibetan name 'Losang'. 'Los' means 'good' and 'Sang' means 'mental'. This name is dedicated to Buddha and signifies a virtuous and thoughtful personality.

in_hindi.name: लोबसाङ
in_hindi.long_meaning: The existence or state of being

in_marathi.name: Lobsang
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dedicated to Buddha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lobsang हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Tibetan name 'Losang'. 'Los' means 'good' and 'Sang' means 'mental'. This name is dedicated to Buddha and signifies a virtuous and thoughtful personality.

in_bengali.name: Lobsang
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Dedicated to Buddha
in_bengali.long_meaning: Lobsang একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Tibetan name 'Losang'. 'Los' means 'good' and 'Sang' means 'mental'. This name is dedicated to Buddha and signifies a virtuous and thoughtful personality.
